source_component.source_reuse: The bounded adapter reuses the existing module and JSON work parser while adding a separate fixed-host request path; the legacy CLI and search() defaults remain unchanged.

facts_used: The Works search parameter searches title, abstract, full text, and keywords.
The default search order is relevance_score descending; the provider says that score reflects text similarity, capped citation count, and a keyword bonus.
Search requests are listed as a metered API request type; reranking adds a separate request cost. This adapter does not request reranking.
The documented per_page maximum is 100; this adapter caps a single page at ten and performs no pagination.
The provider warns against using cursor paging to download the full dataset.
Keyless requests are supported with a provider rate budget; an API key increases the daily budget.
The provider documents request-rate limits and X-RateLimit usage headers.
An API key is account-bound; this adapter sends neither api_key nor Authorization nor mailto.

prior_art_comparison.toolbox_delta: Expose the existing provider's query capability through a typed, one-call, no-key, no-placeholder-email, metadata-only, bounded, explicit-approval toolbox route. This is an adapter-safety and discoverability increment, not a claim that the provider search capability itself is new.

claim_ceiling: One provider response and its selected metadata/usage fields at retrieval time only; no exhaustive recall, human relevance, source authenticity, article content, scientific support, or account billing outcome is established.
